set.body:
Scheduling lane: film. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Preserved approved film-library scope. Follow S0-S4c order and exact text parity; the earlier annotation preview does not close this ticket.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

D1A-TYPES. Governed by docs/plans/2026-09-17-d1a-source-to-story-plan.md (revision 4; owner rulings A, C, D recorded 2026-09-18; decision E open). Read the plan, not this summary, before starting a slice.

Purpose: make the public types that 1.0 freezes able to carry film evidence while every text behaviour stays byte-identical. No film compile path (that is the D1A-film bead).

Slices, each landed on main on its own green gate with S0 values unchanged:
- S0 text parity baseline (test-only): pin the War of the Ghosts compile fingerprint, candidateSet, StoryModelCodec contentChecksum, derivation.json checksum, span/mention renderings, node order, one view artifact; four mutation witnesses.
- S1 ADR 0007 amendment: owner rulings A (research gate removed; S0 answers its engineering reason), D, E; the vocabulary; no-bump argument; rejected alternatives.
- S2 core (core, laws, codec): sealed NarrativeSourceAtlas + AnchoredNarrativeAtlas + BoundProposalSurface; EvidenceSupport.of refusals; per-stream textSpans; canonical interval union and intervalsOn; PrimaryProjection, TypedSupport, Evidence.anchors; evidence-support/v1 codec sub-shape with four anchor-case courts.
- S3 acquire: SourceSupport carries TypedSupport; hasSpans -> hasSupport with every text verdict unchanged.
- S4a node support -> TypedSupport and draft -> Either (model keeps source and SurfaceAtlas).
- S4b envelope, derived non-text identity, TextModel witness and its consumers.
- S4c AlignmentSource sealed and split.

Scope changes from the original bead, all measured: core (source, atlas, claim), laws, codec (story and core), view, pipeline, fixtures, docs-site, embed-bench and align call sites are in. "No align/codec edit" is replaced by: no align scoring change; no 0.7.0 wire change for text; the only codec addition is the self-versioned evidence-support/v1 sub-shape.

Gate per slice: sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll, then scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck separately; docs-site verify:examples from S3; 56/56 test tasks with bound totals; one clean recompile per compile-time probe mutation; named mutation witness per guard; fresh-context cold review per slice. Revision 4 owes a cold review before S2.
set.title: [film] D1A-types: film-capable StoryModel, nodes, Evidence and AlignmentSource, text byte-identical
